claims: NYSE identity/tradability is validated; Q2 operating/backlog data trace to L3Harris issuer reporting and recent independent market data corroborate current valuation context.
Q2 showed $7.3B orders, 1.2x book-to-bill, record $42B backlog, $5.9B revenue and strong cash flow, while capacity expansion and portfolio actions add execution and comparability risks.

thesisQuality.basis: Record backlog, >1x book-to-bill and broad segment growth support durable demand and value capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue, operating margin, operating cash flow and free cash flow were strong with raised guidance.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Shares closed $247.29 on Sep.18, 34.79% below the 52-week high; valuation is balanced rather than clearly distressed.

catalystScore.basis: Capacity expansion, contract conversion and Missile Solutions portfolio action provide material but partly market-dependent catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Execution and cash generation are strong, but portfolio transition and leadership/transaction complexity temper confidence.

alignment2036.basis: Missile defense, space, electronic warfare and resilient defense production address durable strategic infrastructure needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Multiple operating segments reuse defense, space, sensing, communications and propulsion capabilities across independent programs.

bottleneckControl.basis: Propulsion and defense-production capacity expansion addresses constrained mission-critical supply.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Broad program and segment exposure provides multiple demand engines across defense scenarios.

substitutionResilience.basis: Qualified mission-critical systems and program integration create replacement friction, though procurement competition remains.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Capacity investment improves resilience but simultaneous ramps retain supplier and schedule risk.

pricingPower.basis: Mission-critical backlog and margins support pricing power, tempered by fixed/undefinitized government contract economics.

riskEvidence.basis: Primary risks are capacity execution, appropriations, contract economics and government-customer concentration.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Fresh primary financial/backlog evidence plus independent current market data provide broad coverage; future portfolio terms remain uncertain.

scoreRecord.thesis: L3Harris combines broad defense/space demand engines with constrained production capabilities and strong backlog conversion evidence.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Government timing and simultaneous capacity/portfolio execution can weaken realized economics.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Backlog conversion and capacity ramp milestones through the second half of 2026.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore is the Methodology 1.0 weighted component score; risk and confidence remain explicit downstream inputs.
